Arsenic Found In 28 Halloween Candies 🍬 DESCRIPTION: Florida tested 46 Halloween favorites and says 28 contained arsenic, a toxic element linked to cancer. Its highest Jolly Rancher result was 540 parts per billion in Sour Apple. The state says kids should eat no more than six of them a year. It also flagged Nerds Grape at 380, Original Skittles at 370 and Snickers at 350. The results are disputed.
